title: A Debt for the Border
author: Elodie Fairweather
blurb: Yara Yarrow, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
